anacorp-ana-corp:lever:5e70ebed-15d4-407.title: Value Stream & Production Relocation Manager
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:5e70ebed-15d4-407.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California, and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking a Value Stream & Production Relocation Manager in an onsite position in Spartanburg, South Carolina. The Value Stream & Production Relocation Manager owns the performance of assigned product value streams while leading the planning and execution of production relocations across ANA. This role ensures production, equipment, tooling, materials, processes, and people are successfully transitioned with minimal disruption to safety, quality, customer delivery, throughput, and revenue. The position works cross-functionally with Production, Planning, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, Logistics, and Sales to create predictable production flow and execute successful operational transitions. The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 8:00 AM-5:00 PM. This role reports to the Plant Manager with a dotted line to the EVP of Operations.
responsibilities: Value Stream Management:
Own end-to-end performance of assigned value streams.
Drive safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and productivity performance.
Manage production plans, capacity, constraints, and material availability.
Establish daily management, visual KPIs, and clear accountability.
Improve throughput, lead time, flow, and schedule attainment.
Production Relocation:
Develop and execute production relocation plans, schedules, milestones, and risk mitigation.
Coordinate equipment, tooling, inventory, processes, and production transfers.
Manage shutdown, move, installation, commissioning, validation, and restart activities.
Establish inventory buffers and transition plans to protect customer commitments.
Minimize production downtime and operational disruption.
Production Readiness & Ramp-Up:
Ensure equipment, utilities, materials, staffing, training, documentation, and quality requirements are ready before launch.
Develop production restart and ramp-up plans with measurable targets.
Track performance against plan and rapidly resolve constraints.
Stabilize relocated operations before transitioning them into normal production management.
Cross-Functional Leadership:
Coordinate Production, Planning, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, Logistics, and Sales.
Maintain clear visibility of project status, risks, decisions, and actions.
Ensure issues have clear owners and completion dates.
Escalate risks early and drive timely decisions.
Continuous Improvement & People:
Use relocation as an opportunity to improve layouts, material flow, standard work, and productivity.
Apply Lean and structured problem-solving methods.
Develop supervisors, leads, and employees.
Ensure receiving teams are trained and capable of sustaining the new operation.
Other duties as assigned
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field
3 - 5 years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering, supply chain, or a related field, with demonstrated success leading complex operational initiatives.
Proven experience leading manufacturing relocation, facility launch, consolidation, capacity expansion, or production transfer projects.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate projects involving manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, quality, finance, and other key stakeholders.
Strong understanding of production planning, material flow, capacity planning, manufacturing processes, and execution.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify risks and drive timely solutions.
Proven ability to manage aggressive timelines, competing priorities, budgets, and project dependencies in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Excellent communication, leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
Ability to travel between ANA locations and other project sites as required.
Lean/Six Sigma experience is required.
Key Performance Indicators
Safety and quality
Relocation milestones
Production downtime
Restart and ramp-up versus plan
Schedule attainment and on-time delivery
Throughput and lead time
Material availability and inventory
Labor productivity
Equipment readiness
Budget performance
Definition of Success

Successfully transition production from the current operation to the new environment while protecting customer commitments, minimizing downtime, improving operational flow, and establishing a stable, scalable production system for ANA.

bullpentalent-bullpen-talent:ashbyhq:d98.description: INBOUND SALES TEAM MANAGER Location: Remote (LATAM) Working Hours: U.S. Pacific Time Compensation: $1,800 USD per month. Additional bonuses may be available based on performance. Bullpen Talent is hiring an Inbound Sales Team Manager for a U.S. home renovation company. The primary responsibility of this role is to build and manage a team of low-cost remote representatives who handle inbound homeowner inquiries and schedule appointments. Homeowners contact the company directly to: - Request renovation / construction estimates - Schedule appointments - Reschedule appointments - Ask questions about services - Follow up on projects We are looking for someone who has previously built and managed this type of team. RESPONSIBILITIES - Recruit, hire, train, and manage a team of low-cost remote customer service and scheduling representatives - Create processes, scripts, and training materials - Ensure inbound leads are answered quickly and professionally - Monitor team performance and quality - Coach underperforming team members - Maintain strong appointment booking rates - Keep the team motivated, accountable, and productive - Report results and recommend improvements REQUIREMENTS - Experience working for a home services company (roofing, remodeling, HVAC, restoration, windows, landscaping, solar, etc.) - Experience building and managing teams of remote customer service, scheduling, or appointment-setting representatives - Experience recruiting and managing lower-cost remote staff - Experience creating processes and training programs - Strong English communication skills - Available during U.S. business hours - Extremely reliable IDEAL CANDIDATE You have personally built and managed a remote team responsible for handling inbound homeowner inquiries and scheduling appointments. You know how to find good people, train them quickly, manage performance, and keep a lower-cost remote team operating at a high level. Compensation: $1,800 USD per month, plus bonuses after several months of performance. TO APPLY Please tell us: - What type of home services company you worked for - How many people you managed - Where the team was located - How you recruited the team - What results the team achieved

You will own engagements end-to-end, from discovery and scoping through delivery and measurable business outcomes. The role spans greenfield product development, legacy platform modernization, and AI-native enablement. You’ll translate ambiguous business challenges into clear product strategies, priorities, and shippable work. Working closely with clients and technical teams, you’ll help determine where agentic approaches create genuine value. You’ll also establish appropriate guardrails, evaluation criteria, and success metrics for AI-enabled solutions. This is an ideal environment for a hands-on product leader who thrives in consulting, ambiguity, and rapid innovation. Own client engagements end-to-end , serving as the primary product voice from discovery and scoping through delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes. Scope and lead greenfield product initiatives , transforming early-stage ideas into sequenced, prioritized, and shippable roadmaps using AI-native approaches. Manage multiple concurrent client engagements , balancing competing priorities, budgets, timelines, scope, and expected business outcomes. Lead client-facing meetings , including steering committees, sprint reviews, strategic discussions, and conversations involving changes to scope, feasibility, or timelines. Measure and communicate business outcomes , defining ROI and success metrics while ensuring teams remain accountable for meaningful results rather than output alone. Contribute to internal product and delivery practices , developing reusable approaches and playbooks for AI-native builds, platform modernization, and client enablement. Requirements: 5+ years of product management experience , with demonstrated ownership of product scope, roadmaps, priorities, and delivery outcomes. Agency, consulting, or professional services experience , including managing multiple clients or accounts and navigating expectations, scope, budgets, and competing priorities. Comfortable collaborating directly with AI/agentic engineers , including discussions around architecture, evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails. The role combines end-to-end project management, healthcare consulting, stakeholder engagement, and program transformation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca6a7641-808f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Field Training Manager based in the United States. This is a high-impact training and clinical leadership role supporting the adoption of innovative cardiac rhythm management technology across the US. You’ll design and deliver clinical, technical, and soft-skills training for field teams, physicians, and commercial personnel. The role combines hands-on procedural expertise with instructional design, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll support implant procedures, physician education, onboarding, certification, and ongoing competency development while serving as a trusted clinical and technical subject matter expert. You’ll work closely with sales, clinical, medical affairs, marketing, regulatory, quality, and R&D teams to ensure training remains accurate, effective, and compliant. The position offers significant visibility across a fast-growing medical device organization and opportunities to influence product launches, clinical programs, and future education strategies. With approximately 60% travel, this role is ideal for an experienced cardiac device professional who enjoys working directly with clinicians and field teams and wants their expertise to contribute to meaningful patient outcomes. Deliver comprehensive live and remote clinical and technical training programs for internal and external audiences, creating consistently engaging and effective learning experiences. Develop and continuously enhance training curricula, educational materials, certification pathways, and onboarding programs in alignment with the broader global training strategy. Lead onboarding and competency development for new field operations personnel, Field Clinical Specialists, and sales representatives. Conduct knowledge and skills assessments and determine readiness for certification, additional training, or remediation. Provide high-impact physician and field training through in-person procedural case support, virtual education, structured training sessions, and hands-on instruction. Facilitate physician proctoring and live procedural education to promote competency, appropriate technique, and safe adoption of cardiac technology. Serve as a clinical and technical subject matter expert during device implants, follow-up procedures, and clinical investigations. Provide direct procedural supervision, mentorship, and guidance to field personnel to reinforce best practices and established standards. Mentor Field Clinical Specialists and other training personnel to strengthen clinical, technical, and procedural capabilities. Partner with clinical, sales, marketing, medical affairs, regulatory, quality, and R&D teams to ensure consistent product messaging and compliant training content. Support training initiatives associated with new product launches and evolving technologies. Collaborate with training leadership to develop scalable learning resources and structured educational programs. Help plan and execute physician education programs, hands-on cadaver laboratories, animal labs, KOL programs, and other professional education events. Monitor training performance, trainee feedback, and learning metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and demonstrate program effectiveness. Provide field-based insights that can inform product development, clinical trial protocols, and future training strategies. Represent the organization at relevant conferences, workshops, and professional education forums. Travel approximately 60% of the time, including overnight and occasional weekend travel, to support field activities and educational programs. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:aec0e41d-042.description: About the Role Are you passionate about pop culture, films, television, and the ever-evolving world of streaming media? We are seeking dynamic Entertainment Media Content Contributors to join our team! In this role, you’ll review and evaluate model-generated responses to user queries about entertainment media, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and quality. Your expertise will help shape outputs that resonate with fans of cinematic universes, episodic storytelling, and pop culture at large. Responsibilities - Review contributor evaluations of model-generated responses to ensure adherence to project-specific guidelines and rubric dimensions. - Verify that contributors consistently apply all instructions, constraints, and evaluation criteria when assessing model responses. - Confirm that contributors accurately identify factual errors, hallucinations, or missing information in model responses, ensuring evaluations reflect whether responses fulfill the user query. - Ensure contributor-selected options align appropriately with rubric dimensions and are justified by the evidence present in the model response. - Review open-text comments provided by contributors, ensuring they identify areas of opportunity, weaknesses, or limitations that may not have been captured by rubric criteria. - Provide detailed feedback on contributor performance, highlighting areas for improvement and ensuring evaluations are consistently high-quality. Project Details: Location: Remote in the Mexico Job Type: Freelance Pay Rate: $6 USD /hour Expected capacity: 20 hours per week Start date: As soon as possible Requirements: Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: - Film and media studies - Entertainment journalism, film criticism, or media commentary - Content analysis focused on movies, TV series, and streaming platforms - Entertainment blogging, reviewing, or significant contributions to pop culture communities - Pop culture commentary and media writing Strong familiarity with: - Narrative structures, character arcs, and continuity across cinematic universes and episodic storytelling - Contextual and cultural references specific to entertainment media Proven experience in: - Roles involving AI data annotation, content quality review, or search quality rating - Evaluating content using structured grading criteria and providing thoughtful, constructive feedback - Meticulous attention to detail and the ability to identify nuanced issues in content - Ability to work independently and manage workflows effectively in a remote environment - Familiarity with data annotation platforms and model evaluation tools Preferred qualifications: - Prior experience of reviewing, evaluating or analysing content in an entertainment-related capacity - An in-depth understanding of current trends in pop culture and the entertainment industry - The ability to interpret prompts referencing specific storylines, characters, franchises, and broader entertainment contexts - Active use of major streaming platforms and strong familiarity with their catalog of films, television series, and original content

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:dd816cbd-adf.description: About Welo Life Sciences Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com Role Overview The Life Sciences Senior Product Manager is a cross-functional position that requires taking ownership and responsibility for a Life Sciences product/service and all issues and considerations related to it. As a Product Manager, you’ll be the bridge between product stakeholders and the development team, taking the business requirements and defining the product requirements. Success depends on your ability to have deep knowledge of our customers' journey, the Welocalize business, and the impact of data.
responsibilities: Strategic Development: Play a central role in building capabilities that will empower multiple business-critical software projects.

Roadmap Leadership: Build insights into Welocalize use cases, strategize where software solutions can be applied to drive business impact and use these insights to build and champion the product roadmap.
Cross-functional collaboration: Closely partner with outstanding talent across engineering teams and drive tight integration with other systems to build effective software solutions.
Objective Setting: Define clear OKRs to ensure progress towards our goal of driving software adoption and effectiveness.
Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal operational stakeholders, external clients, and our engineering team to ensure product success.

Requirement Analysis & Solution Design: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, define clear objectives, and develop technical plans. Work with stakeholders to identify opportunities where software can provide valuable insights and solutions.

Performance Assessment: Develop metrics that reflect the needs of the business for their stakeholder cases, partner in the analysis of experiment results, interpret findings, and provide actionable recommendations.
Industry Awareness: Stay updated with the latest advancements in software development, technologies, and methodologies.

Experience with clinical trial management systems or patient data handling is preferred.
Familiarity with global regulatory requirements pertaining to clinical trials and document management will be valued.
Strong practical knowledge of MS Office, Atlassian (JIRA, Confluence).
Background in cloud solutions, SaaS platforms, or enterprise software development.

Quantitative Skills: Strong ability to seek out, understand, and dive into data, research, and others' thoughts to support data-driven decision-making.

Communication Skills: A well-rounded communicator, collaborator, and presenter who loves to share findings and insights. Strong verbal and written communication skills (including analysis, interpretation, & reasoning)
Methodology Understanding: Understanding of Lean and Agile methodologies.
Attention to Detail: Self-motivated with critical attention to detail, deadlines, and reporting.

Facilitation Skills: Demonstrated ability to facilitate cross-functional planning sessions (e.g., Scrum and Squad in Agile).
Team Inspiration: Demonstrated ability to effectively partner across, collaborate with, and inspire teams and individuals, including remote employees.
Negotiation Skills: Ability to negotiate and resolve complex and sensitive issues with diplomacy and persuasiveness.
